## Appearance

Jonas is a big, loose-jointed figure distinguished by absurdly long legs. He has tow-colored, lank hair, green eyes, and a big mouth.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)_

## History

Jonas [Blake](../character/blake.md) was a theological student who spent a summer at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), having resisted becoming a minister for a long time before pursuing his studies. During his time there, he met [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), who initially found him funny and ugly. However, after delivering a deeply moving sermon, he earned her profound admiration and caused her to nervously realize that she might be falling in love with him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Jonas P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 ch.Jonas P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023), [v3 ch.Christine P2](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0002), [v3 ch.Christine P3](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0003), +8 more_

## Relationships

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jonas--phil-gordon.md)

Jonas first met [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) while working as a theological student. Although [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) initially found him funny and ugly, she was deeply moved after hearing him deliver a sermon and realized her growing admiration for him. The two eventually became engaged and married, sharing close companionship as good chums who enjoyed walking, fishing, and boating together.

- Friend of — good chums who fished, boated, and walked together  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
